scope: Read-only review of final deterministic game core, renderer/input/dialogue code, build/verification code and authored map layout; one independent edge probe against the final embedded runtime layout.

resolvedFindings.problem: The initial 0.24 m player radius and 0.23 m NPC half-width allowed oversized Garden heads to intersect neighbors and source walls.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Final build derives footprints from actual GLB node-transformed position bounds. Player envelope rotates with validated yaw; NPC circles use the full model circumradius plus 1 cm. Independent checks matched all five model bounds to actual occupied source geometry and proved all five interaction stations remain reachable.

resolvedFindings.problem: Direction-based held-key Set dropped a direction when one of two equivalent physical bindings was released.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Final input tracks event.code, so W plus ArrowUp remain independently held and released. Blur, hidden-document, modal-open and modal-close clear input state.

resolvedFindings.problem: Interpolating a visual 0-to-90 degree heading could pass through a wider 45 degree head footprint even when endpoint headings fit.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Rendered player yaw matches validated state yaw immediately; unsafe desired turns are deferred in movement. Player idle head yaw is zero. NPC turning and head sway remain inside conservative circumradius.

reviewedBehaviors.movement: Normalized diagonal speed, capped/substepped frames, wall sliding, map containment, actual yaw-aware player footprint, conservative NPC footprints, reachable conversation and market stations.
reviewedBehaviors.input: Physical key-code release; modal/blur/visibility clearing; pointer capture plus pointer-up/cancel/lost-capture clearing; pointer cancellation performs no extra step; short taps and keyboard controls have explicit step paths.
reviewedBehaviors.conversations: Native modal dialog stops player movement. Conversation pages and nearby emoji handlers are attached to the selected station. Close/Escape reaches the dialog close listener, clears session/input and restores a connected prior focus target.
reviewedBehaviors.transactions: Offer preview is pure. Confirm passes current layout into core and rechecks market range. Successful trades return fresh nested inventory/stock/player state; coin/item/stock updates are atomic. Failed offers preserve prior state. Cancellation returns to market without a commit. Reset rebuilds initial coins, inventory, stock and spawn.
reviewedBehaviors.paletteAndAnimation: Shared canonical palette atlas is replaced consistently on base and emissive materials; identity-protected Garden theme uses the same catalog. Five loaded characters require the actual six exported rigid pivots; arm and leg gait rotates those joints. Reduced-motion path suppresses gait bob/sway.

checks: physics bounds independently match actual occupied source geometry
state preservation on preview and failed trades
embedded original GLB bytes and source hashes
embedded layout and full palette catalog match sources
six actual rigid pivots for all five characters
actual model footprints and yaw rotation
all five stations reachable with larger avatar envelope

limitations: This report does not claim live browser gesture, focus or frame-rate measurement. The coordinator performs live UI validation separately.
Environment collision is a deliberate conservative axis-aligned approximation of source-derived character-height solids.
